Question: Let \(E\) be the point of intersection of the diagonals of convex quadrilateral \(ABCD,\) and let \(P,\) \(Q,\) \(R\) and \(S\) be the centers of the circles circumscribing triangles \(ABE,\) \(BCE,\) \(CDE\) and \(ADE,\) respectively. Then

Choices.B:
\(PQRS\) is a parallelogram if and only if \(ABCD\) is a
rhombus
Choices.C:
\(PQRS\) is a parallelogram if and only if \(ABCD\) is a
rectangle
Choices.D:
\(PQRS\) is a parallelogram if and only if \(ABCD\) is a
parallelogram
Choices.E: none of the above are true
